_comment: Known pre-existing lint errors, enforced by scripts/lint-gate.mjs. CI fails if a linter CRASH occurs (always) or if the error count EXCEEDS these numbers. Lower these as the backlog is burned down; never raise them.
_context: ESLint was crashing repo-wide on v10 (eslint-plugin-react caps at ^9.7), so lint had been dead and CI ran it as continue-on-error. Pinning to ^9.39.5 revealed this backlog.
